image_description: Two individuals standing outdoors in academic regalia. The person on the left wears a gold-colored gown and a mortarboard cap with a tassel. The person on the right wears a black academic gown with colored velvet panels (likely indicating doctoral status) over a white shirt and tie, holding a rolled diploma. Background consists of blurred green foliage and tree trunks.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/hip level; the lower half of the garments and ankles are not visible, making full-length verification impossible.
Both gowns exhibit clear bilateral symmetry and a vertical center-front opening consistent with academic robe construction.
The fabric drapes loosely, effectively hiding the underlying body shape, particularly around the torso and arms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject on the left clearly displays the characteristic wide, bell-shaped sleeve openings that extend past the wrists/hands.
Visible lapels and front edges indicate the standard panel structure of academic gowns.
The subject on the right clearly wears a collared shirt and tie underneath the gown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The black gown shows low specular highlights consistent with heavy matte fabric; the gold gown has a slight sheen but remains within plausible material bounds for satin-lined academic wear.
Fabric texture appears smooth without chaotic noise or excessive gloss.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Sleeve geometry matches the expected drape of academic regalia.

artifact_observations.location: Background foliage and tree trunk behind the subjects
artifact_observations.reasoning: The background exhibits a 'painterly' or smeared texture typical of AI generation or aggressive bokeh simulation, lacking distinct leaf structures and showing slight color bleeding into the subjects' hair.

artifact_observations.location: Hands holding the diploma (Subject on Right)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers merging with the rolled paper lack clear anatomical definition; the grip appears physically implausible with fused digits and unclear boundary between skin and paper.
Slight softness and blending between the hair strands and the gown shoulder seam, suggesting minor edge coherence issues.
